olga_marketing: Morning team 5252 noticed inbound claim SLA drifting past ~6m for US leads after yesterday's webinar campaign. Can we triage? :wave:
tom_salesops: I saw a heap of 502/timeout responses from HubSpot enrichment between 10:00-11:30 UTC. Leads queued at RR.
maya_revops: Drop a sample lead id and any enrichment traces, pls. Need to see if it's enrichment or RR contention.
olga_marketing: sample lead 00D-55512. Logs: ```
ENRICH POST /api/enrich 200 2024-02-13T10:03:12Z
ENRICH GET 00D-55512 2024-02-13T10:03:14Z 504 Gateway Timeout
RR CLAIM attempt=1 2024-02-13T10:03:15Z
RR CLAIM backoff=4s attempt=2 2024-02-13T10:03:19Z
RR CLAIM success 2024-02-13T10:08:20Z
```
dev_infra: That backoff pattern is the culprit. Current retry policy (3 attempts, doubling) means some leads sit >5m before assignment if enrichment flakes.
tom_salesops: Proposed change: fast-path assign if enrichment not returned within 7s. Use minimal enrich payload (email, company, region) to assign owner, then patch rest asynchronously.
maya_revops: +1. Also suggest low-touch rule: if lead_score < 15 skip enrichment entirely and run a 2h re-enrich job for misses.
emily_support: For on-call, let's add an alert: name=LeadRouting_P95_High threshold=600s (10m) -> pages revops + infra. Include playbook steps to run `kubectl logs -l app=rr-worker -n routing --since=30m` and a KQL to surface enrichment 5xx spikes.
dev_infra: I'll add metric tags step={enqueue,enrich,claim,sf-sync} and a latency histogram. We'll also implement region-specific RR worker pools so NA/EMEA don't compete for the same workers.
tom_salesops: Plan experiment: feature-flagged rollout, start with 1% of inbound -> fast-path, monitor median claim, P95, and conversion rate. If stable, bump to 20% then full.
maya_revops: I'll update the HS->SF mapping doc and the workflow rules to reflect the low-touch path and the re-enrich job. Notifying sales ops and CS after docs are updated.
dev_infra: ETA: feature flag + metrics by EOD today for the canary. Region pools and re-enrich job early next week.
emily_support: Drafting the playbook entry now and will commit to the runbook repo. Alert will be enabled in staging for the canary.
hs_sync_bot: HubSpot sync: 7 retried, 1 failed in last hour 5252 see https://internal.hubspot/logs/1913456789
tom_salesops: Scheduling a 30m war-room 14:00 PT to lock thresholds and approve canary percent. Invite sent.
olga_marketing: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll draft the experiment brief (metrics: median_claim, p95_claim, conversion, SLA_to_sales) and link the doc here once ready: https://go/redwood/docs/lead-routing-fast-path
